modules.title: Getting Set Up
modules.content:
## Basketball Mobile App: Minimum Requirements

### Hardware

- iPhone
  - iPhone 11 or later, with the exception of iPhone 13 Mini
- iPad
  - 8th or later
- iPad mini
  - All models

### iOS

- iOS 13.4

### Android

- Android 8.1 (27 api level)

### Hard Drive Space

There are no requirements for the amount of hard drive space necessary for the application. However, hard drive space is required to download video for offline playback. The amount of space needed is determined by the number of videos being downloaded.

### Internet Bandwidth

We recommend a sustained bandwidth of at least 3.5 Mbps for uninterrupted streaming of Synergy video.

Next Up - Basketball Mobile App: Downloading and Installing the App (see the “Getting Set Up” lesson)

## Basketball Mobile App: Downloading and Installing the App

### Direct Links for App Install:

App Store (Apple):<https://apps.apple.com/us/app/synergy-sports-mobile/id6462990172>

Play Store (Android):<https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sportradar.coaching.mobile>

###

### Download and Install

1. Open the App Store on your device by clicking the App Store icon.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Downloading and Installing the App](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565563-01.jpg)

2. Use the search bar to find the **Synergy Sports Mobile** app, and then click on the install button to download the app to your device.

> Note: You may be prompted by the App Store to enter your Apple ID. This is the username and password you use to install apps and make changes to your iPad. This username and password is not affiliated with Synergy Sports Technology.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Downloading and Installing the App](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565563-02.jpg)

Next Up - Basketball Mobile App: Logging in to the App (see the “Getting Set Up” lesson)

## Basketball Mobile App: Logging in to the App

Links to App

App Store (Apple):<https://apps.apple.com/us/app/synergy-sports-mobile/id6462990172>

Play Store (Android):<https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sportradar.coaching.mobile>

###

###

### Logging In

1. After you install the app on your device, click on the Synergy Sports Mobile icon.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Logging in to the App](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565564-01.png)

2. Enter your Synergy Username and Password and then press the **Login**button.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Logging in to the App](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565564-02.jpg)

3. If it's your first time logging in, you may be asked to upload a Profile Photo and/or allow Push Notifications. You can choose to skip these steps if you wish.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Logging in to the App](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565564-03.jpg)

4. You will be directed to the **Dashboard** of the Mobile App.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Logging in to the App](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565564-04.jpg)

 Next Up - Basketball Mobile App: Navigating the Dashboard (see the “Dashboard and Settings” lesson)

modules.title: Dashboard and Settings
modules.content:
## Basketball Mobile App: Navigating the Dashboard

After you log into the Synergy Mobile App, you will land on the Dashboard. This is where you will find your main navigation tools for the Mobile App.

### Dashboard Tools

There are three main icons on the Dashboard: Analytics, Edits, and Games.

> Note:The Analytics icon is currently only available on tablets.

- **Team Site Icon:** this icon will open the Team Site in your internet browser
- **Edits Icon:** this is where users can find edits that they have created, received, and/or sent.
- **Full Games Icon:** this is where users find full-game videos

###

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Navigating the Dashboard](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565565-01.jpg)

###

### Recent Items and Favorites

Favorites and Recent Items will be listed at the bottom of the Dashboard page.

- **Recent Items:** The video clips you have recently watched
- **Favorites:** Videos that you have marked as a "Favorite"

####

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Navigating the Dashboard](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565565-02.jpg)

#### Marking Favorite Videos

To mark a video as a "Favorite" you can click the heart icon next to any video in the app. To unmark the video, you can click on the heart icon again.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Navigating the Dashboard](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565565-03.jpg)

Next Up -Basketball Mobile App: Main Menu and User Settings (see the “Dashboard and Settings” lesson)

## Basketball Mobile App:  User Settings

###

### Settings

Clicking on your initials in the upper right corner will reveal the Mobile App Settings.

####

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App:  User Settings](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565566-01.jpg)

####

On the Settings page users will find several options:

- Profile Settings
- Download Settings
- Notifications
- App Tour
- Mute by Default
- Log Out

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App:  User Settings](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565566-02.jpg)

#####

#####

##### Profile Settings

Profile Settings are where you can update your name and picture in the application. If you are a part of multiple leagues, this is also where you can switch your sport.

**
![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App:  User Settings](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565566-03.jpg)**

Download Settings

The download settings allow you to change the download resolution and select whether the Mobile App can download using your device's data or only over the internet.

**
![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App:  User Settings](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565566-04.jpg)**

Notifications

The notifications settings allow you to select whether or not you would like to be notified when you receive an edit.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App:  User Settings](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565566-05.jpg)

App Tour

The app tour will give you some quick tips about the Mobile App.

**
![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App:  User Settings](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565566-06.jpg)**

Next Up - Basketball Mobile App: Watch Custom Edits and Source Edits (see the “Watching Video” lesson)

modules.title: Watching Video
modules.content:
## Basketball Mobile App: Watching Edits

### Watching Edits

To get to Custom Edits and Timeline Edits, click the **Edit** button on the Dashboard.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Watching Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565567-01.jpg)

On the Edits page, select whether you wish to view Custom Edits or Timelines.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Watching Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565567-02.jpg)

Search for the name of the edit that you wish to watch using the search bar or scroll through the lists.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Watching Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565567-03.jpg)

Click on the name of an edit to open that edit.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Watching Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565567-04.jpg)

Then your edit should appear in the video player.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Watching Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565567-05.jpg)

If you are on an iPad, you may need to turn your device vertically to see the clips in the edit. This should also reveal the back button, which can take you back to the Edits page.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Watching Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565567-06.jpg)

Next Up - Basketball Mobile App: Watch Playlists from Team Site (see the “Watching Video” lesson)

## Basketball Mobile App: Watch Playlists from Team Site

The Synergy Mobile App is linked to Team Site, where you can find video playlists tied to statistics. For example, you can choose to watch a player or team's 3-point shots, rebounds, steals, etc.

> Note: Access to Team Site via the Mobile App is currently only available for tablets.

###

### Open Playlists from Team Site

Click on the Analytics tab. This tab will take you directly to Team Site.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Watch Playlists from Team Site](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565568-01.jpg)

Log in to Team Site with your Synergy credentials.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Watch Playlists from Team Site](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565568-02.jpg)

Once you are logged in, navigate to the stats for the Player, Team, or Game that you wish to review. To get more information on navigating Team Site, you can check out the [Team Site Guide here.](https://support.synergysports.com/hc/en-us/sections/360013361231-Synergy-Team-Site)

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Watch Playlists from Team Site](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565568-03.jpg)

Click on the stat you wish to view.

> Note: Any statistic listed in blue indicates there is an associated video.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Watch Playlists from Team Site](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565568-04.jpg)

After you click on the stat you wish to view, the **Video Playback Parameters** will pop up. Make sure the **Playback** dropdown is set to **Mobile App**, and then click **OK.**

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Watch Playlists from Team Site](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565568-05.jpg)

The video clips will open in the Mobile App browser.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Watch Playlists from Team Site](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565568-06.jpg)

Next Up - Basketball Mobile App: View Full Game Videos (see the “Watching Video” lesson)

## Basketball Mobile App: View Full Game Videos

The Synergy Mobile App makes it easy to access full game videos on the go.  Below are the steps for finding and viewing games.

View Full Games

Click the **Full Games** icon on the Dashboard

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: View Full Game Videos](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565569-01.jpg)

Once you are on the Games page, click the **Filters** button.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: View Full Game Videos](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565569-02.jpg)

On the **Filters** page, click the filter you wish to update.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: View Full Game Videos](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565569-03.jpg)

Mark your selections, and then click the back button to return to the Filters page.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: View Full Game Videos](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565569-04.jpg)

Apply all of your filters, and then click the back button to navigate back to the Games page.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: View Full Game Videos](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565569-05.jpg)

Once you are back on the Games page, click the game you wish to watch.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: View Full Game Videos](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565569-06.jpg)

The game will open in the video player.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: View Full Game Videos](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565569-07.jpg)

Saving Filters

You have the option to save your filter selections by clicking the **Save** icon on the **Filters** page.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: View Full Game Videos](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565569-08.jpg)

Create a name and save the filter selections for future use.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: View Full Game Videos](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565569-09.jpg)

This selection will now appear under the Saved tab.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: View Full Game Videos](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565569-10.jpg)

Next Up - Basketball Mobile App: Manage Videos for Offline Playback (see the “Offline Playback and Sharing Edits” lesson)

modules.title: Offline Playback and Sharing Edits
modules.content:
## Basketball Mobile App: Manage Videos for Offline Playback

Downloading videos in the Synergy Mobile App will allow you to watch videos offline, which can be very useful if you are traveling without access to the internet.

Before downloading videos, you may wish to change the download resolution for your device and/or select whether the Mobile App can download using your device's data or only over the internet. To learn how to make these changes you can read Basketball Mobile App: User Settings (see the “Dashboard and Settings” lesson).

###

### Downloading Videos

Navigate to the edit or game video you wish to download, and then click the **download icon**. A progress bar will appear around the download icon to let you know your video is downloading.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Manage Videos for Offline Playback](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565570-01.jpg)

Once a download is complete, the download icon will change to a checkmark. Videos that have this checkmark will be viewable offline.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Manage Videos for Offline Playback](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565570-02.jpg)

If you wish to remove the download, click the checkmark again. Then confirm your delete selection.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Manage Videos for Offline Playback](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565570-03.jpg)

Downloads Page

To see all your downloads in one place, click on the **Downloads** tab.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Manage Videos for Offline Playback](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565570-04.jpg)

Click on the bullets on the right to play or delete a download.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Manage Videos for Offline Playback](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565570-05.jpg)

Select the Play or Delete option when they appear.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Manage Videos for Offline Playback](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565570-06.jpg)

Next Up - Basketball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers (see the “Offline Playback and Sharing Edits” lesson)

## Basketball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers

The Synergy Mobile App can be used to send edits and see who has viewed the edits you have sent. Below are the instructions for sending edits and monitoring viewers.

### Send Edits

Navigate to your edits by clicking on the **Edits** icon on the Dashboard.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565571-01.jpg)

Click on the edit that you wish to send.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565571-02.jpg)

After you select an edit, you will see three tabs:**Clips**, **Share**, and **Raw Video**.

> Note: If you are on a tablet, you may need to hold your device vertically for these tabs to appear.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565571-03.jpg)

 Select the **Share** tab and then you will see a**Share** button.

> Note:If you have already sent this clip before, you will need to select the Share icon (*see below*).

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565571-04.jpg)

Click on the Share button, and then select whether you wish to share with **Synergy** users or **Create a URL**:

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565571-05.jpg)

- The **Synergy** option will include the members of your team. Select which users you want to share your edit with, and then click **Send**.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565571-06.jpg)

- The **Create a URL** option will allow you to send a link to Synergy users outside of the Mobile App. You can elect to send the link via Airdrop, iMessage, email, etc.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565571-07.jpg)

If you need to send a clip that was already shared, you can click the **Share icon** to send the clip to additional recipients.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565571-08.jpg)

####

####

### Monitor Viewers

Once an edit has been sent, you can use the**Share** tab to see who has viewed the edit..

> Note: Only Synergy recipients will be listed in the Distribution List. See the instructions above if you do not know how to navigate to the Distribution List tab.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565571-09.jpg)

Next Up - Basketball Mobile App: Create New Edits (see the “Offline Playback and Sharing Edits” lesson)

## Basketball Mobile App: Create New Edits

In the Synergy Mobile App, you can compile clips from different edits to make a New Edit. Below are the instructions for creating a new edit.

### Creating New Edits

Navigate to the Edits icon on the Dashboard.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Create New Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565572-01.jpg)

On the Edits page, click the **New Edit** button.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Create New Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565572-02.jpg)

Give your New Edit a name and click **Save**.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Create New Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565572-03.jpg)

Select an Edit with clips that you wish to add to your New Edit.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Create New Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565572-04.jpg)

After you select an Edit, you will see a list of clips. Press and hold down on a clip to select or deselect that clip. A red bar will appear if you have selected a clip.

> Note: If you are on a tablet, you may need to hold your device vertically to complete these tasks.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Create New Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565572-05.jpg)

Once your selections are made, click on the **Arrow** icon.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Create New Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565572-06.jpg)

Then select the New Edit you created, and click **Save**.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Create New Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565572-07.jpg)

Your new edit and the added clips will be available in your **Custom****Edits**.

![Screenshot: Basketball Mobile App: Create New Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565572-08.jpg)
